targets.review_note: Count pairs consisting of an index-selected subsequence and one marked occurrence of the pattern inside it. Before the marked occurrence starts and after it ends, each source character may be kept or skipped, giving diagonal factor2; while inside the occurrence, nonmatching intervening characters must be skipped, giving diagonal factor1. Matching the next pattern character advances one state. These lower-triangular linear transformations compose over concatenated Fibonacci words as T(F_i)=T(F_(i-2))*T(F_(i-1)). The final entry from initial state0 to completed staten counts all occurrences, including overlaps and distinct index selections yielding equal strings, without constructing exponential-length words.
